capabilities: Display emoji icons beside notes and folders in the file explorer
Declare note and folder icons with file_icon and folder_icon frontmatter properties
Set global folder icons for vault-relative paths in settings
Flag invalid values and conflicting folder_icon declarations with warning markers
Expose an API (getFileIcon, getFolderIcon, getIcon) for scripts and DataviewJS dashboards
extras: Install section describes manual copying into the plugins folder for testing; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Icons are stored with notes in frontmatter, so moving a note or folder does not leave a path-keyed icon behind.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows no per-file or per-folder markers, and icon sets keyed by path break when notes are moved.

relations.evidence: In a DataviewJS block, use getIcon to show icons in a dashboard table

summary: Reads emoji from file_icon and folder_icon frontmatter properties and displays them beside notes and folders in the file explorer.
